book.name: MATEUS
book.title: MATEUS Mateus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Israel gabat kame tuku maŋau
Kile Yesus nu nuŋe dubiwanu taŋgo maŋgur suŋgo ta turmba saniŋgina:
Kusem pasa tugunu bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal nane Moses taŋaŋ tukul pasa bitekŋga sanu tuku ndo piro ta biyig ta
nane sakade pasa ta nane kumu ndade. Tane nane sakade ta dubikap sulumba nane tuku maŋau dubi ndakap.
Nane tukul maŋau gudommba agaŋ pitinu taŋaŋ taŋgo mbolŋge patika minde bada suŋgo niŋgig ta nane naŋgine miroŋ fudiŋmba tur ndakade.

Nane afuŋge kaŋgerkuwaig ŋga nane taŋgo am mbolŋge wam magenu kade. Nane tukul pasa patinu tuku niŋgot wakeika tukul pasa kuyarka sigrika tumail mbol wai mbol kusmba ŋak likade. Naŋgine tawi mbolŋge nzale kugennu wakeikade.
Nane pagumba nye suŋgo ko kusem wandekŋge nane taŋgo tumailamŋge minyokam tuku nzaliniŋgit.
Nane maket mbolŋge lika taŋgo nane sugo ŋga kaiyeniŋguwaig ŋga kilba pilig. Afuŋge nane kaŋgerka tum taŋgo ŋgade le nane gare suŋgoniŋgit.
Tane taŋa ndawap. Ande nu tane tum taŋgo ŋguwa kande tane nu peuwap. Ndindo ndo nu Tum Taŋgo minit. Tane ŋakmba kumu kumu tira minig.
Kilke te mbolŋge gabat taŋgo ande yiŋe mam nda ŋgap. Tane tuku Mam ndindo nu samba mbolŋge minit.
Afuŋge tane sugo ŋguwaig kande tane nane peuniŋgap. Tane tuku Suŋgo ndindo ndo minit. Nu Kristus.
Tane ŋgamukŋge ima nu suŋgo minam idusmba ndeta nu tane ŋakmba tuku piro taŋgo taŋaŋ minwa.
Ande nu nuŋe nyu payamkuwa ta Kuateŋge nu tuku nyu te-ibeŋamŋgat. Ande nu nuŋe nyu yabukuwa ta Kuateŋge nu tuku nyu te-mayokamŋgat.
Kusem gabat mbal tuku yabri maŋau

Kusem pasa tugunu bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal ose. Tane yabri taŋgo ndo. Tane nane afu Kuate tuku gageu mayok kambim tuku ndin tukulde. Tane Kuate tuku gageu mayok kambim mbulmba nane afu mayok kambim bafude le nane peuniŋgig.

[Osese. Kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal tane pino kuembol kame tuku agaŋ ndende didika kile-suluwe niŋgig. Taŋgine ŋayonu ta yabukam tuku taŋgo am mbolŋge Kuate yabaŋ kuende. Ta tuku tane pa lato tamŋgaig.]

Osese. Kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal tane taŋgine dubikanu taŋgo ndindo ndo te-silinu tuku yu mbol mbol kilke mbol mbol sota ma masken kinig. Ande tane dubikate le taŋgine yabri maŋau ta tumde le nu tane litiŋmba pa suŋgo ŋayo tam tuku minit.

Tane am tukulok minmba tugusemba ndin tum ndaniŋgig mbal ose. Tane teŋenmba sakade. Ande nu nuŋe pasa saŋgri pilewam tuku kusem wande nyun tate ta ake. Nu kusem wande sinamŋge golmbi wakeikinaig agaŋ kame nyun kilig ta nu nuŋe pasa ta kumuwa ŋgade.
Tane am tukulok ŋginŋgan mbal ndo. Gol kame ta Kuate tuku wande sinamŋge minig tukunu nane tukul. Kuate tuku wande ta gol kame liniŋgit.
Tane teŋenmba mata sakade. Ande nu nuŋe pasa saŋgri pilewam tuku Kuate tuku atrau mbain nyun tate ta ake. Nu atraukam tuku agaŋ mbain mbolŋge minit ta nyun tate ta nu nuŋe pasa ta kumuwa ŋgade.
Tane siŋka am tukulok mbal ndo. Atraukam tuku agaŋ ta atrau mbain mbolŋge minit tukunu nu tukul. Atrau mbain ta atrau agaŋ lite.
Ta tuku ande nu nuŋe pasa saŋgri pilewam tuku atrau mbain nyun tate ta agaŋ mbain mbolŋge minit ta turmba nyun tate.
Ande nu nuŋe pasa saŋgri pilewam tuku wande suŋgo nyun tate ta Kuate nu wande ta mbolŋge minit nu turmba nyun tate.
Ande nu nuŋe pasa saŋgri pilewam tuku samba nyun tate ta nu Kuate tuku minyo mbili suŋgo turmba nyun tumba Kuate nu ta mbolŋge minit nu mata nyun tate.

Kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal ose. Tane yabri taŋgo ndo. Tane tukul ande dubimba piro kareŋka agaŋ foŋfoŋ ŋguna ilinzu ŋakmba maŋgur 10 patika ande Kuate tuwig. Tane taŋade sulumba tane tukul maŋau sugo kusreka maŋau tiŋreknu mape maŋau taŋgo pino ŋgamukŋge ke ndaka taŋgine piro tugusemba biye ndakade. Tane tukul sugo ta turmba kade kande maye kande.
Tane am tukulok minmba taŋgo pino tugusemba ndin tum ndaniŋgig. Tane ŋgailmbo kule sinamŋge kaŋgermba pitaide sulumba kamel kule sinamŋge minit ta kaŋger ndamba kule tur ŋinkade.

Kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal ose. Tane yabri taŋgo ndo. Tane taŋgine waim nza saŋgilnu minya mayede ta taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal agaŋ ndende gudommba kilam tuku piririmba agaŋ terokam tuku wamdus liganu minig.
Farisi mbal tane am tukulok minig. Taŋgine waim nza sinanu kutur ŋakmba ta sauka minya mayewap le saŋgilnu turmba kau prowa.
Kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal ose. Tane yabri taŋgo ndo. Taŋgo kumu mbolŋge ndame suku kaukauk mindepiye mayenu prote ta sinam taŋge isu meŋga mundurkate taŋaŋ tane minig.
Tane taŋgo am mbolŋge tiŋreknu ndo minig. Taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal sinamŋge yabri maŋau kutur maŋau ligmba meŋga minig.
Kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal Farisi mbal ose. Tane yabri taŋgo ndo. Tane tuan taŋgo kame tuku kumu mbolŋge ndame magenu patika taŋgo tiŋreknu tuku kumu mbolŋge mindepiye mayenu patika sakade:
Sine tuku mbuŋ kame tuku ait mbolŋge sine mingeŋ kande nane tuan taŋgo kame tuku ndare kutuwe niŋginaig ta sine nane ndoŋ ulendi ndakigeŋ kande ŋgade.
Tane taŋamba pasa sakade ta taŋgine tugu te-mayokde. Kuate tuku tuan taŋgo kame bale farniŋginaig mbal ta tane nane tuku fat ŋgade.
Ese. Tane taŋgine mbuŋ kame tuku maŋau ŋaigonu ta tuturap le suŋgokuwa.
Tane mbeŋ ŋaigonu tuku fat. Tane pa ŋayonu tam tuku minig. Tane pa ta laipam tuku ndin kuga.

Ta tuku ye tuan taŋgo kame taŋgo wamdus kuyar magenu Kuate tuku pasa kukliwam tuku kukulniŋgi le tane tugum prowaig le tane nane afu kilmba bale farka afu ail kazrai mbolŋge patikamŋgaig. Afu taŋgine kusem wandekŋge ŋgusniŋmba afu kilmba amsesekap le nane kua ka sili-silimba tumbraŋ ŋakmba mbol kine prowamŋgaig.

Tane taŋawap le taŋgo tiŋreknu kilke te mbolŋge bale farde ta nane ŋakmba tuku ndare taŋge tane pasokamŋgat. Abo abo taŋgo tiŋreknu Abel nu tugu pilmba ndare kutukina. Ta tuturmba kumba ka nane Berekia tuku kiŋo nuŋe Sakaria nu Kuate mbariŋam tuku mbain atrau mbain ŋgamukŋge minna le nane pro nu balemba ndare kutunaig.
Ye siŋka satiŋgamŋgit. Nane ŋakmba ndare kutuniŋge likinaig ndare taŋge tane pasokamŋgat ŋga saniŋgina sulumba sakina:

O Yerusalem, Kuate nu buk tuan taŋgo kame kukulniŋgina le ne kilmba bale farmba afu ndamembi bale farniŋgina. Teg inonu fat kilmba tawo sirite taŋaŋ ye tane kilmba tawo siriwam bafuwet le tane ye ram kua kinig.
Tane isap. Kile Kuate nu tane ŋgamukŋge mine ndakate.
Ye tane satiŋget. Tane ye nda kaŋgeryap sulumba maŋ kaŋgeryumba ndek sakamŋgaig. Ne Suŋgo tuku nyu mbolŋge prote. Suŋgoŋge ne nyaro tinwa ŋga sakamŋgaig ŋgina.
